title: Pooled model zoo pooled-zoo-417: selection, development and scored evaluation

statements.title: Scope.
statements.text: Descriptive evidence: the warm-up fold selects one candidate and variant per search partition; the scored folds evaluate those frozen choices; the holdout from 2026-01-30 is never evaluated.

statements.title: Admission.
statements.text: A ticker enters a fold once its fit band holds 40 rows; until then its calibration and scored rows are dropped for every model and listed in the admission tables.

statements.title: Intervals.
statements.text: Skill is 100 x (1 - model / horizon_empirical) on weighted_crps. The paired date-block bootstrap intervals pool every scored ticker with equal cell weight; the per-ticker table is point skill without an interval.

statements.title: Gaps.
statements.text: n/a marks a value a model or stage did not produce, never a zero.
